references.text: Describes a vision of the Son of Man coming with the clouds, which resembles the description in Mark 13:26.
Refers to the day of the Lord, where the Lord comes with all his holy ones, paralleling the idea of a divine entry with power and glory.
Daniel sees in his night visions, and this parallels the description of the Son of Man coming with the clouds in Mark 13:26.
Refers to Jesus coming with the clouds, and everyone will see him, including those who pierced him, resonating with the description of the Son of Man coming in Mark 13:26.
Speaks of the Lord God coming with power, and his arm shall rule for him, which can be seen as parallel to the description of power in Mark 13:26.
Refers to the glory from the Lord rising over you, which may relate to the glory mentioned in Mark 13:26.
